source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Seven adds: five county/town campgrounds (Dauphin Island's 151-site town campground, Cullman County's 219-site Smith Lake Park and its Stony Lonesome OHV park, Mobile County's Escatawpa Hollow, Tuscaloosa County's Van de Graaff, Bear Creek's Twin Forks) plus St. Stephens Historical Park (commission-run, filed state). AL held only 33 local entries; the 2026-06 sweep was RV-Life-based and missed large public campgrounds, so the gap here is Midwest-sized, not seaboard-sized. Good Sam's AL rows were absent from the cache until a full re-fetch 2026-09-27.
